title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - Otafuku Army Headquarters (Rotating Pillars Room)
description:
A very simple background found in the Rotating Pillars room of the Otafuku Army Headquarters, from The Legend of the Mystical Ninja.

Uses only 11 tiles, meaning the users can combine it easily with other stuff. A good fit for japanese temples, in general.
